claims.text: The tweets were filtered based on names of target clubs and annotated for stance as Favor or Against.
A total of 700 tweets were annotated, with an equal distribution of 175 tweets for each stance towards two targets.
The annotations included the tweet ID, stance target name, and the stance (Favor or Against) in a publicly available CSV format.
